name: Miko Shimai ~Shokushu Jusei Jigoku~
original_name: 巫女姉妹～触手受精地獄～
source:
The Dark Age where darkness dominates the night.
Shrine maidens family lives peacefully on an isolated island till the family is assaulted and assassinated. The two surviving girls seek a way to survive. What they don't know is that God already abandoned this land.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个由黑暗支配夜晚的黑暗时代。

一个巫女家族在与世隔绝的岛屿上平静生活，直到家族遭到袭击，族人惨遭杀害。幸存的两名少女开始寻找活下去的方法，却并不知道神明早已抛弃了这片土地。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
